title: CI Failure Triage
trigger: Authenticated GitHub Actions failure webhook after ingress verification and minimization
actions: classify build, test, configuration, or security failure
special: Never push, commit, open a code-changing PR, merge, deploy, or edit repository contents.

title: Support Intake
trigger: Authenticated support/contact-record webhook after ingress verification and minimization
actions: send an approved acknowledgement by account reference
record acknowledgement success only after Resend confirms delivery
special: Never place raw contact text in n8n, a model, an issue, notification, audit, retry, or dead letter. Prompt-injection signals require manual privacy review.

title: Beta User Onboarding
trigger: Authenticated approved-beta-account webhook after ingress verification and minimization
actions: include educational disclaimer and setup guide
special: Never activate payment, imply advice, trade, request broker credentials, or include portfolio data.

title: Provider Outage Alert
actions: classify market_closed, setup_required, degraded, or verified_outage
special: Never classify scheduled closure, unconfigured provider, empty data, or one transient response as verified outage.

title: Sentry Critical Issue Triage
trigger: Authenticated Sentry critical-issue webhook after ingress verification and minimization
special: Never include tokens, headers, cookies, private bodies, request bodies, stack-local secrets, or user financial data.

title: Uptime and Readiness Monitor
actions: check auth, database, provider, contact, broker-vault, CRT-storage, saved-research, and waitlist readiness
classify operational, degraded, setup_required, or outage
notify only when the state fingerprint changes
special: setup_required is configuration state, not outage. Reachability is not readiness. Report current setup-required gates and contact 404 exactly; never auto-configure.

title: Weekly SEO Report
actions: read Search Console aggregates when connected
read Core Web Vitals and broken links
special: Never generate/publish low-quality articles, modify the site, auto-submit URLs, or include query-level personal data.

title: Weekly Product Analytics Digest
actions: query allowlisted aggregate PostHog events only
special: Never use financial data, session replay, raw properties, distinct IDs, emails, or unapproved events.

title: Daily Support Digest
actions: list response deadlines by opaque task reference
special: Never include raw messages, names, emails, phones, financial data, or model interpretations of private text.

title: Release Verification
trigger: Authenticated successful production-deployment webhook after ingress verification and minimization
actions: run fixed safe GET/HEAD route checks
special: Never merge, deploy, roll back, mutate configuration, purge data, or equate deployment success with readiness.
